notes: The total number of Event Points that the player has earned is tracked during the event as Cumulative Event Points. The player receive rewards for reaching certain Event Point milestones.
Once a player had earned 200,000 event points, they would receive 50 R Jewels for every additional 30000 event points they proceeded to earn in the event.

notes: After a team match ends and the player's team disbands, they are awarded a number of Treasure Boxes, depending on a number of factors including their own performance and their team's performance.
After a Round ends, the player is awarded a number of Treasure Boxes, depending on whether their faction won or lost the round.
Gold Treasure Boxes and Silver Treasure Boxes contain different rewards. Gold Treasure Boxes only contain Gems or cards that are R or above.

The Card Trader EX appears during this event and remained open until one week after its conclusion. The player can trade their EX Jewels for cards, Booster Items, and Gold. Each card and Booster Item can only be obtained once from the Card Trader EX during this event, but the Gold can be obtained any number of times.
